messages:
Maria: seeing a weird tail in eu-central proxy 503s since ~09:10 UTC, looks correlated with one tenant (T-42). briefly spiky RPS and then proxy OOMs?
Ken: can you paste the proxy logs / status?
Maria: pasted the last 2m dump, filtered: `proxy_eu_central | tenant=T-42 | 503_count=112 | mem_rss=1.8G -> 2.4G`
Maria: also noticed the backend pool for shared-slice-eu has almost zero headroom on burst lanes.
Tara: ugh that tenant's workload is a heavy streaming rerank job right now. are they on shared or dedicated?
Leo: T-42 is on shared by default, no dedicated commit. they started a big eval earlier today.
Sahil: ops-bot flagged repeated slow downstreams: `latency_p50=80ms p95=1.2s p99=3.5s` during the window. sounds like head-of-line at the proxy + kv-cache churn.
Maria: proposal: soft denylist / tenant-exclusion in proxy routing for short windows (shed traffic from T-42 to lower-cost fallback model or reject with 429 to protect tail).
Ken: agree. we have a non-invasive path: proxy supports `exclude_tenants` flag (runtime) and a per-tenant `fallback_route` mapping.
Ken: config example I tested locally:
```
proxy.routing:
  exclude_tenants: ["T-42"]
  fallback_map:
    "T-42": "/models/compact-rerank-v1"
```
Maria: nice. question: will exclude_tenants affect billing/quotas? we shouldn't silently drop billing meters.
Leo: exclude_tenants only changes runtime routing. meters still count at acceptance point. if we return 429 we can add `metering_reason=denied_shielding` tag.
Tara: operationally we need to coordinate with support/AMs—T-42 might be a paid seat. We should notify before denying.
Sahil: can we do a canary rollout: start with `fallback_map` to compact model (cheaper) for 5 minutes, then escalate to exclude if still noisy?
Ken: yes, feature-flag `tenant_exclusion_v2` exists in edge-ff. I'll prepare a toggle with two steps: fallback -> exclude -> notify.
Maria: canary plan sounds good. also add a short TTL so the exclude auto-expire after 10m.
Ken: will implement TTL in the runtime: `exclude_tenants_ttl: 600s`.
ops-bot: deploy-trigger: created canary rollout job `canary/tenant-exclusion/1728600123` -> queued on eu-central (stage).
Tara: who will run the canary? I can start after 10:30 UTC, notify SRE rotation.
Leo: I'll watch proxy metrics + KV cache miss rate. will have alert if p99 > 2s or 503s > 5/min.
Sahil: add cost note: switching to compact model reduces token cost ~3x, but increases error rate slightly. product/regrets?
Tara: we'll ping the tenant owner and offer a dedicated pool if they need throughput guarantees. cost recourse via account team.
Maria: timeline: Ken to push config + FF, Tara to notify tenant, Leo to monitor, Sahil to observe cost/quality delta, Maria will document incident.
Ken: prepping PR: small runtime change + migration for TTL and metering tag. expecting to merge in ~20m.
Maria: thanks. if we see this pattern more than 3x/wk we should add automated detection and opt-in shielding tiers.
Leo: noted. will sketch an alert rule for recurring tenant noise.
Tara: adding action item for support playbook: "shielding vs dedicated upsell".
Maria: :thumbsup:
Ken: kicking off canary now.
ops-bot: canary started: `canary/tenant-exclusion/1728600123` -> step 1 (fallback) active.
